parsed.post: Discarding LR=0.05 (0.899) as it regressed from 0.866. It seems LR=0.05 was too slow for this capacity/batch size combination. Reverting to b731e77 (0.866) and will try increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to see if we can find a better sweet spot for DEPTH=6.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.08 on the best DEPTH=6 configuration to see if higher learning rate improves convergence within the 5-minute budget.
